source_findings.finding: low_cpu_mem_usage and offload_state_dict are removed as unused kwargs in this installed version.
Empty/meta construction and initial tying precede shard loading; tying is repeated after all shards finish.
The loader casts each serialized parameter and assigns it to its named module. The serialized output head can be allocated separately before final tying.

float() delegates to _apply. Ordinary compatible dense CPU parameters retain their Parameter object through param.data assignment under default conversion flags. Both flags default false; no override was found in inspected repo services/tools or installed Transformers/PEFT/Accelerate.
from_pretrained sets in-memory config.dtype; Module.float does not correct it. torch_dtype is a deprecated alias.
Default Qwen3 RoPE inv_freq is a nonpersistent buffer explicitly computed in FP32, independent of the load dtype.
